item.title: Pakistan conducts overnight strike on Taliban corps in northern Afghanistan | Amu TV
item.description: Hamad Wasil, a spokesman for the Taliban’s Al-Fath Corps in Balkh, said Taliban forces fired at the drones in northern Afghanistan.

item.title: 10 players withdraw from Afghanistan squad ahead of key matches | Amu TV
item.description: The federation said most of the players had initially confirmed their availability but later reversed their decision shortly before the matches.

item.title: Clashes erupt near Zabul as Taliban-Pakistan truce ends | Amu TV
item.description: Sources say fighting broke out Monday night in Shimalzai district along the border with Pakistan.

item.title: Displaced by border clashes, families in Nangarhar struggle in makeshift camps | Amu TV
item.description: Many of the displaced say they are struggling to meet even their most basic needs.

item.title: Tuberculosis still major health challenge in Afghanistan, WHO says | Amu TV
item.description: The WHO called for urgent, coordinated action to expand early diagnosis, improve access to treatment and ensure that no patients are left behind.

item.title: Kandahar, Helmand to host new season of regional cricket tournament | Amu TV
item.description: Matches will be held at Kandahar Cricket Ground and Helmand Cricket Ground, with games starting at 10 a.m. local time.

item.title: Taliban release US detainee Dennis Coyle | Amu TV
item.description: The release comes amid growing pressure from US officials over the detention of American citizens in Afghanistan.

item.title: Taliban link Coyle's release to family appeal, talks | Amu TV
item.description: The Taliban have said Coyle was detained for violating “Afghanistan’s laws”, though they have not specified the charges.

item.title: Family urges release of Mahmood Shah Habibi after Coyle freed | Amu TV
item.description: Global Reach said it has been assisting the Habibi family since shortly after his disappearance.

item.title: US seeks release of other Americans held by Taliban as Coyle freed | Amu TV
item.description: Rubio said Coyle is on his way home after more than a year in captivity, calling his release a positive step.
